metadata.referenceArchitecture: NVIDIA NemotronH (Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B, Apache-2.0 reference equations)
metadata.precisionNote: Parameters and inputs are identical IEEE-754 Float32 values across PyTorch and TypeScript. TypeScript accumulates inner dot products in JS float64 before Math.fround at tensor writes, whereas PyTorch torch.float32 accumulates in float32 BLAS/SIMD; expected max abs parity error <= 1e-5.
